title: Openlogi widens scope of 8–9 November unauthorized access to its logistics system
date_note: Openlogi first disclosed the access on 11 November; this record dates its second notice of 17 November, which widened the data affected.
geo_basis: country; the notices read name no city
summary: Openlogi says in notices of 11 and 17 November that a third party accessed its system on 8–9 November and took part of its shipment data. The second notice widens the data to shipment requests from 27 October 2017 to 25 November 2024 and 9 November 2026, with only some data taken and scope varying by client. Openlogi says scope and counts are under investigation and it has confirmed no misuse.
plain: A Japanese logistics service says an outsider took part of its shipment data, including recipients' names, addresses and phone numbers. It has found no misuse so far.
exec: Online sellers using Openlogi may have had their customers' delivery details taken; the scope and counts are still under investigation.
action: Openlogi asks clients to tell recipients to ignore unexpected delivery notices, avoid suspicious URLs and not enter personal or payment details when asked.
impact: No total published; scope and counts under investigation.

validation.note: Primary source: Openlogi's own notices of 11 and 17 Nov. The piyolog summary relays client notices; they were not read.
